answers: Right there on the first screen, under the 'WY Driver's Test' heading, it says 'Real test: 25 questions, 20 correct to pass (80%)'.

If I look at the 'About this test' section, under 'OFFICIAL TEST LANGUAGES', it just says 'English'. Also, at the very top of the screen, only the 'EN' button has a green checkmark, and a tiny note says the checkmark means it's offered on the official DOT test.

In the 'About this test' dropdown, it lists the source as the '2021 Class C Driver License Manual (dot.state.wy.us)'. It also has a green checkmark next to the text 'All 247 questions verified against the official manual'. Below that, it shows 'Grade A', 'Fidelity 10/10', 'Topic coverage 100%', and says 'Verified Jul 27, 2026'.

I got a terrible score of 0%, so I failed. It tells me this loud and clear with a big circle in the middle of the screen showing '0%' and the word 'FAIL' in pinkish-red letters. Below the circle, it says 'Keep Practicing!' and 'You got 0 out of 10 correct.'

On the 'Your Progress' screen, the box labeled 'QUIZZES' shows a big blue '1', so I've only taken one quiz. Down in the 'Score History' box, there's no chart because the text inside says 'Take one more quiz to see the chart'.

The hardest things for my old eyes are the tiny gray paragraphs on the results screen under my missed questions, like the one that starts with 'While crashes can occur at any time, the manual notes...'. I also really struggled to read the small gray note at the very top of the screen about the checkmark, and the tiny gray text under 'OFFICIAL TEST LANGUAGES' on the second screen. There's just not enough contrast against the dark background.
